name: Fuyutsuki Chiharu
source:
A girl who committed suicide due to unknown reasons. Her school denied any claims that she was bullied. Her suicide case was reopened [url=/v45398]6 years later[/url] by both her [url=/c129116]former teacher[/url] and news reporter [url=/c73543]Minorikawa Minoru[/url].

[url=/v1299]Ten years after her death[/url], Minorikawa still remembers Chiharu's suicide and how the incident fueled him to become a freelancer reporter.
